title: 第6章 灭口密令李慕白领命第5章 夜窥秘辛符文指引迷途
slug: 长生从假死开始万年之后我还在
content_zh:
晨钟第二响刚落，陈默还站在杂役居所的屋檐下。扫帚靠墙，肩头那片草屑已被风吹走。他低头看着自己的手，指节发白，是刚才攥扫帚攥得太紧。阳光照在脸上，暖的，但后颈有些发凉。
他知道，自己昨晚动了禁地符文的事，可能没瞒住。
执法堂的灵觉符不是摆设，波动再微弱也会留痕。玄霄子那种人，对威胁的嗅觉比狗还灵。他不敢抬头看主峰方向，只把头垂得更低，像真傻了一样盯着脚前那块青石板上的裂缝——里面钻出一株细弱的野草，正被风摇来晃去。
他不动，也不说话，等下一个差事。
只要不被单独叫走，就没事。
只要还在人群里混着，他们就不会动手。
活得久的人，从不抢风头。
主峰之上，掌门殿深处，密室门闭。
玄霄子坐在蒲团上，指尖捏着一枚传讯玉简，脸色阴沉。玉简刚送来不到半盏茶时间，内容只有两句：
“后山禁地外围，灵觉符昨夜申时三刻有微弱灵力波动，持续七息。”
“柴房囚徒陈默，今晨神志清明，非痴傻之状。”
他把玉简捏碎了，粉末从指缝漏下，落在地面发出沙沙声。
他知道陈默没死，当年那一推只是个开始。可他没想到，这小子不仅活着回来，还敢往禁地凑。
断龙崖下的符文，是宗门最高禁忌之一，连内门长老都不得窥探。若陈默真看懂了什么，把坠崖真相和符文联系起来，四处乱说……正道盟追究下来，他这个掌门首当其冲。
一个弃徒的命不值钱，可他的位置值钱。
他站起身，在密室里来回走了三圈，最终停下，抬手拍下墙上一道隐秘符印。
青烟升起，凝成一道短讯，直奔东侧偏殿。
李慕白正在练剑。
白衣胜雪，玉带束腰，青霜剑在他手中划出一道道寒光，剑尖点地时连一片落叶都不曾惊动。他收剑归鞘，嘴角含笑，对旁边侍立的弟子道：“今日功课已毕，你去吧。”
那弟子退下后，他脸上的笑才一点点淡去。

他早就收到消息——陈默回来了，装疯卖傻混进杂役队。他还听说，昨夜后山灵觉符有异动。
他不意外。
陈默那种人，命硬得离谱。小时候在药园偷吃毒果，别人中招倒地，他睡一觉就醒了；宗门大比前夜被人下药，他喝完水桶倒扣，第二天照样上场。
可这次，他不会再让这家伙苟下去。
门外传来轻叩声。
“大师兄，掌门召见，密室相谈。”
李慕白整了整衣袖，点头：“知道了。”
他拿起青霜剑，轻轻抚过剑身，像是在安抚一头即将出笼的兽。
掌门殿偏殿，门从里面锁上。
玄霄子背对着门口站着，听见脚步声也没回头。直到李慕白行礼完毕，他才缓缓转身，目光如刀。
“你可知我为何单独召你？”
“弟子不知。”李慕白低头，声音恭敬，“但若为陈默之事，弟子愿效犬马之劳。”
玄霄子盯着他看了两息，忽然冷笑：“你还记得他被推下断龙崖那天，是谁动的手吗？”
“是执法堂四位师兄合力押送，弟子……也在场。”他顿了顿，语气诚恳，“当时便觉得可惜。毕竟一起入门，情同手足。”
“情同手足？”玄霄子声音压低，“他要是真把你当师兄，就不会昨夜偷偷摸到后山，触动禁地符文。”
李慕白眉头微皱，露出恰到好处的震惊：“他……去了那里？”
“灵觉符有记录。”玄霄子走近一步，声音几乎贴着他耳朵响起，“他装疯，是为了骗过所有人。可他瞒不过阵法。那地方不该有人去，尤其不该是他去。”
content_en:
The second ring of the morning bell had just fallen, and Chen Mo was still standing under the eaves of the servant's residence. The broom was leaning against the wall, and the grass clippings on my shoulders had been blown away by the wind. He looked down at his hands, his knuckles were white because he had gripped the broom too tightly just now. The sun was shining on my face, making it warm, but the back of my neck felt cold.
He knew that he might not have concealed the fact that he had touched the forbidden rune last night.
The spiritual awareness talisman of the Law Enforcement Hall is not a decoration. No matter how weak the fluctuation is, it will leave traces. People like Xuan Xiaozi have a better sense of threat than a dog. He did not dare to raise his head to look in the direction of the main peak. He only lowered his head lower and stared at the crack in the bluestone in front of his feet as if he were really stupid - a thin weed emerged from it and was being swayed by the wind.
He didn't move or speak, waiting for the next errand.
As long as you don't get called away alone, you'll be fine.
As long as they were mingling among the crowd, they would not take action.
People who live long never steal the limelight.
On top of the main peak, deep in the Master's Palace, the secret room door is closed.
Xuan Xiaozi sat on the futon, holding a jade slip with a message on his fingertips, his face gloomy. The jade slip had just been delivered less than half a cup of tea, and contained only two sentences:
"On the outskirts of the forbidden area of ​​the back mountain, the spiritual awakening talisman had weak spiritual power fluctuations at three o'clock in the morning last night, which lasted for seven breaths."
"Chen Mo, the prisoner in the woodshed, is in a clear state of mind this morning and is not stupid."
He crushed the jade slip, and the powder leaked from his fingers and fell to the ground with a rustling sound.
He knew that Chen Mo was not dead, and that push back then was just the beginning. But he didn't expect that this kid not only came back alive, but also dared to go to the forbidden area.
The runes under Broken Dragon Cliff are one of the highest taboos of the sect, and even the elders of the inner sect are not allowed to pry into them. If Chen Mo really understood something, connected the truth about the cliff fall with the runes, and spread nonsense... If the Righteous Alliance pursues the case, he, the leader, will bear the brunt.
The life of an outcast is not valuable, but his position is.
He stood up and walked back and forth in the secret room three times before finally stopping and raising his hand to pat down a secret talisman on the wall.
The green smoke rose and condensed into a short message, heading straight to the east side hall.
Li Mubai is practicing his sword.
The white clothes are better than the snow, and the jade belt is tied around his waist. The green frost sword draws cold light in his hand. When the sword tip touches the ground, it does not even disturb a fallen leaf. He sheathed his sword, with a smile on his lips, and said to the disciple standing next to him: "Today's homework is done, you can go."
After the disciple retreated, the smile on his face gradually faded away.
He had received the news a long time ago - Chen Mo was back, pretending to be crazy and sneaking into the handyman team. He also heard that there was a strange movement in the back mountain spiritual talisman last night.
He wasn't surprised.
People like Chen Mo are extremely tough. When he was a child, he secretly ate poisonous fruit in the medicine garden, and others were poisoned and fell to the ground, but he woke up after a nap; he was drugged the night before the sect competition, and he drank the bucket and tipped it upside down, but he still played the next day.
But this time, he won't let this guy go on.
There was a light knock at the door.
"Elder brother, the master has summoned us to have a secret meeting."
Li Mubai adjusted his sleeves and nodded: "I understand."
He picked up the Qingshuang Sword and gently stroked the blade, as if comforting a beast about to be released from its cage.
The door of the side hall of the head palace is locked from the inside.
Xuan Xiaozi stood with his back to the door and did not look back when he heard the footsteps. It wasn't until Li Mubai finished saluting that he slowly turned around, his eyes like daggers.
"Do you know why I called you alone?"
"I don't know, disciple." Li Mubai lowered his head and said in a respectful voice, "But if it is Chen Mo's business, I am willing to do my best."
Xuan Xiaozi stared at him for a few breaths, then suddenly sneered: "Do you still remember who did it that day when he was pushed off Dragon Broken Cliff?"
"It was the four senior brothers from the Law Enforcement Hall who jointly escorted me, and the disciple... was also present." He paused and said in a sincere tone, "I felt it was a pity at the time. After all, we started together and we are brothers."
"Being brothers?" Xuan Xiaozi lowered his voice, "If he really regarded you as his senior brother, he wouldn't have sneaked into the back mountain last night and touched the forbidden rune."
Li Mubai frowned slightly, showing just the right amount of shock: "He... went there? "
“The spiritual awareness talisman has records. Xuan Xiaozi took a step closer, and his voice sounded almost close to his ears, "He pretended to be crazy to deceive everyone." But he couldn't hide the formation. No one should go to that place, especially not him. "
